Fixes #30140 (this was especially noticeable when using Ctrl + Shift + W shortcut)

Scene tab handling might use some refactor, because there are multiple pretty equivalent ways to close a tab.
pr_comments: Needs a rebase on current `master` to fix CI.

issue_context.title: Scene Label force save bug.
issue_context.body:
**Godot version:**
3.1.1

**OS/device including version:**
10.14


**Issue description:**
here has two way for close scene label:
1. click "x"
2. cmd+shift+w or right click label select "close scene"

here has problem with the 2nd way. It will force saving ( or loading ) for a while. It is not nessacery.

review_comments: What if you have unsaved work?
It will ask you if you want to save. It basically does what the code below do, but in a different place.

Why do `FILE_CLOSE_ALL_AND_QUIT` and `FILE_CLOSE_ALL_AND_RUN_PROJECT_MANAGER` use a different logic then?

And what about the preview generation further down after the `[[fallthrough]]`?

> Why do FILE_CLOSE_ALL_AND_QUIT and FILE_CLOSE_ALL_AND_RUN_PROJECT_MANAGER use a different logic then?

No idea tbh. This should be probably unified, see #40539

> And what about the preview generation further down after the [[fallthrough]]?

If it was generated *without saving* then it won't anymore. Closing current tab now works the same as middle-clicking it.
